summary: The streaming DeepSeek path no longer attaches the fixed buffered deadline, and the focused test verifies a producing stream survives it.

evidence: src/deepseek/handlers.ts selects the downstream signal for streamed bodies instead of inferenceSignal, preventing the buffered wall-clock signal from terminating the stream.
tests/openai-compat-part10.test.ts simulates the buffered deadline firing after 20 ms while the stream emits its next frame after 60 ms, and asserts both frames plus [DONE] are delivered.
